# Pidgin Host Provider

The Pidgin Host provider manages resources in the [Pidgin Host](https://www.pidginhost.com) cloud: servers, private networks, public and floating IPs, firewalls, volumes, object storage buckets and SSH keys.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    pidginhost = {
      source = "mihai-amihailesei/pidginhost"
    }
  }
}

# The token is read from the PIDGINHOST_TOKEN environment variable when it is
# not set here. Never commit a token to version control.
provider "pidginhost" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_url` (String) Base URL of the API. Defaults to `https://www.pidginhost.com`. Can also be set with the `PIDGINHOST_API_URL` environment variable.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) API token, sent as `Authorization: Token <token>`. Create one in the Pidgin Host control panel under *Account → API tokens*. Can also be set with the `PIDGINHOST_TOKEN` environment variable.
